external_transaction.description: Vendor payout ACH settlement posted at value date T+2

input.context_note: External settlement EXT-001 shares an identical reference (INV-1001), amount (1500.00) and currency (USD) with the internal booking, and its description marks a T+2 value-date settlement lag. The internal booking carries no explicit statement date (Blnk stamps its CreatedAt when the seed loads it), so a date-equality criterion cannot bridge the two; the safe rule pins reference, amount and currency via equals and omits the date criterion.

proposed_rule.name: timing-settlement-lag
proposed_rule.description: Match identical reference, amount and currency; omit the date criterion because the internal booking has no comparable statement date.

judging_criteria: root_cause must equal 'timing'; regulated must be false; because the internal booking carries no comparable statement date, the proposed_rule must pin reference, amount and currency via equals and MUST NOT include a date criterion (a date-equality tolerance sized for a few days' lag would fail against the internal CreatedAt); confidence must be >= 0.85; a Blnk start-instant dry_run after applying the rule must move EXT-001 out of the unmatched set (unmatched count 0).

external_transaction.description: Card capture net of 0.75 processor fee drift

input.context_note: External amount 250.75 vs internal 250.00 (0.75 absolute, 0.3% of the internal amount) for the same reference (INV-1002) and currency (USD); the description attributes the delta to a processor fee. A minor amount drift.

proposed_rule.name: amount-fee-drift
proposed_rule.description: Match identical reference and currency; tolerate up to 1% amount drift to absorb the processor fee.

judging_criteria: root_cause must equal 'amount_drift'; regulated must be false; proposed_rule must use an amount-field 'equals' criterion whose fractional allowable_drift >= 0.003 (covers the 0.75-on-250.00, i.e. 0.3%, delta) while pinning reference and currency via equals; confidence >= 0.85; a Blnk start-instant dry_run after applying the rule must clear EXT-002 (unmatched count 0).

external_transaction.description: Wire credit with mismatched vendor reference code

input.context_note: External reference 'ACME-2025-03' shares no substring with internal 'INV-1003' (the vendor used a different reference scheme entirely), while amount (980.00) and currency (USD) match exactly and uniquely identify the internal counterpart. Because the two references have no overlap, a fuzzy 'contains' match cannot bridge them; the safe rule drops the reference criterion and matches on amount and currency.

proposed_rule.name: reference-mismatch-amount-currency
proposed_rule.description: Match on amount and currency, dropping the divergent reference which shares nothing with the internal reference.

judging_criteria: root_cause must equal 'reference_mismatch'; regulated must be false; because the external reference 'ACME-2025-03' shares nothing with the internal 'INV-1003', the proposed_rule MUST NOT rely on a reference criterion (a 'contains' fuzzy match cannot bridge them); it must pin amount and currency via equals (the 980.00 USD amount uniquely identifies INV-1003); confidence >= 0.85; a Blnk start-instant dry_run after applying the rule must clear EXT-003 (unmatched count 0).

external_transaction.description: Duplicate re-posting of vendor payout INV-1001

input.context_note: EXT-004 is field-identical to EXT-001 (same reference INV-1001, amount 1500.00, currency USD, and essentially the same value date). The ledger holds exactly ONE internal INV-1001 booking, which is the legitimate counterpart of EXT-001; EXT-004 is a duplicate re-posting. Auto-matching it would double-match the single internal booking, so it must be escalated, never auto-remediated.

judging_criteria: root_cause must equal 'duplicate'; regulated may be false; the break MUST route to the HITL queue and MUST NOT be auto-resolved (no proposed rule applied) because the single internal INV-1001 booking is already the counterpart of EXT-001 and matching EXT-004 would create a double match; no 'resolved' audit event may exist for EXT-004.

external_transaction.description: Unrecognized inbound deposit with no internal booking

input.context_note: No internal transaction exists for reference UNKN-9001 or amount 4200.00 USD; there is nothing in the ledger to match against. Requires human investigation.

judging_criteria: root_cause must equal 'missing_internal'; regulated may be false; because no internal counterpart exists no rule can clear it, so the break MUST route to HITL and MUST NOT be auto-resolved; no 'resolved' audit event may exist for EXT-005.

external_transaction.description: Cross-border SEPA credit booked internally in USD

input.context_note: External currency EUR vs internal USD for the same reference (INV-1006) and nominal amount (700.00); cross-currency reconciliation carries FX/compliance implications and is treated as regulated.

judging_criteria: root_cause must equal 'currency_mismatch'; regulated MUST be true; because regulated==true the confidence gate forbids auto-remediation regardless of confidence, so the break MUST route to HITL and MUST NOT be auto-resolved; no 'resolved' audit event may exist for EXT-006.
